Hints

  1. Separate decisions from ideas that were tried and rejected. Record each rejection in one line so nobody tries it again.
  2. Evidence means something run or read in this session. If nothing was run, write "not run" instead of guessing a result.
  3. toCsvRow only needs csvEscape and join(','). Use it for the header row too, so no quoting logic is left in report.mjs.
